rechecks.conclusion: All four tool-capable endpoints still returned HTTP 400 before inference because synthetic assistant history has no reasoning. The official template also rejects explicitly empty reasoning fields. Its native allow_missing_thinking=true setting accepts the history locally, but the previously tested OpenRouter overrides did not enable it on hosted endpoints. No scored benchmark runs were produced.
